# Doc Keeper

> Doc Keeper is an offline document vault for Android. It keeps photos and PDFs of IDs, licences, insurance cards, certificates and contracts encrypted on the phone (AES-256-GCM), with no account, no server, no analytics and no ads. Ten documents are free; unlimited documents is a one-time purchase.

- [Home, features and questions](https://dork7.github.io/cardholder/)
- [Privacy policy](https://dork7.github.io/cardholder/privacy.html)
